feedback: Cary's confession follows the clearest factual contradiction I underweighted: his plain-spare story denied the photographed crest glass and tried to sever the forensic chain. The sealed delivery never excluded theft during the open preview, so my preference for Elle's fabric route was a circumstantial inference rather than an exclusion of Cary. The confession supplies the precise theft and transfer actions, but the underlying means, access, motive, and false vessel account were available before voting. Elle's financial admission makes her route an effective alternative rather than a fabricated clue. Cary's final line about never being asked to move anything again is restrained and emotionally apt. I find the reveal earned, though a little more chronological differentiation would improve confidence before the vote.
